fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance maternal and child health by providing nutritional support to first-time pregnant women and mothers of young children during the crucial first 1000 days of life.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to promote higher education among OBC students in Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance to students pursuing professional and academic courses at the post-matriculation level.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of Fees of ST Students Studying in Sainik School Private Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The "Reimbursement of Fees for ST Students" scheme by the Tribal Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh, offers free accommodation, school fees, and education for eligible students in Sainik Schools and private institutions.

fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
fields.briefDescription: The Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides aid to 20 students yearly with family income under ₹8 lakh, 75% in postgraduation, and teaching experience or an M.Phil degree.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme" by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides working capital assistance of up to ₹10,000, promotes regular loan repayment, and trains entrepreneurs in business practices. The scheme targets small traders.

fields.schemeName: Free Distribution of Text Books to Students
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2008, the scheme "Free Distribution of Textbooks to Students" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

fields.schemeName: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides free pre-examination training to eligible candidates for various competitive exams to enhance their preparation and improve their chances of success.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Food Security Scheme (JSFSS)" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to ensure food security by providing subsidized/free rice to eligible Green Card holders.

fields.schemeName: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
fields.briefDescription: The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides a scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls for 10 months.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Distribution of Kerosene Oil Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, supports NFSA beneficiaries and others by providing 1 liter of kerosene oil at subsidized rates.

fields.schemeName: Strengthening Skills, Arts and Employment through ITIs
fields.briefDescription: The "Strengthening Skills, Arts, and Employment through ITIs" initiative by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to connect these skills with modern technology, short-term, employment-oriented training has been provided through ITIs.

fields.schemeName: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
fields.briefDescription: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Madhya Pradesh Government encourages girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to study. Girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time receive ₹3,000/-

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Pulses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Distribution of Pulses" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution, and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, aims to ensure food security by providing pulses at affordable rates to eligible households under NFSA and JSFSS.

fields.schemeName: Incentive Scheme in Civil Service (Chhattisgarh)
fields.briefDescription: "Incentive Scheme in Civil Service"  aims to encourage bright and meritorious persons with disabilities to pass competitive exams in the field of civil services. Financial support is provided on passing the different stages of the Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Exams.

fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC  and DNT Students for studying in India
fields.briefDescription: "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC  and DNT Students for studying in India" aims at providing financial assistance to OBC, EWS and DNT students to support their education. The scholarship covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other academic expenses.

fields.schemeName: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)
fields.briefDescription: "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Rural)" aims to disburse monthly pensions to old age citizens, both male and female, who are 65 years of age or above and are destitute (with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon). To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana Jharkhand
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana" by the Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to unemployed candidates who have completed skill training programs aligned with NSQF.

fields.schemeName: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme" by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana, aims to promote academic excellence among students in government colleges. It provides financial incentives to top-performing students based on merit in annual examinations.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage (HPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The Financial Assistance for Marriage scheme under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides ₹51,000/- for the marriage of a registered unmarried beneficiary and ₹51,000/- per child for the marriage of up to two children of a married beneficiary.

fields.schemeName: IT Saksham Yuva Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Haryana Government is to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of a minimum of 3 months offered.

fields.schemeName: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)
fields.briefDescription: "INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to widows irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana" aims to eliminate caste discrimination and promote social harmony. Under this scheme, eligible inter-caste married couples receive a financial incentive.

fields.schemeName: Grishm Kaleen Dhan Ke Badle Dalhan, Tilhan, Makka Fasal ko Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on April 30, 2014,  under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. The scheme aims to promote the cultivation of pulses, oilseeds, and maize as an alternative to summer rice, helping to conserve groundwater.

fields.schemeName: Food Bill Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The "Food Bill Assistance" scheme provides financial support to non-reserved category students pursuing graduate-level medical, dental, technical, and para-medical courses.

fields.schemeName: Interest Help Scheme For Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate
fields.briefDescription: The "Interest Help Scheme for Graduate Doctor-Lawyer-Technical Graduate" aims to provide financial assistance in the form of interest subsidy on loans to the non-reserved category professionals in Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage brilliant students and inculcate a spirit of competition among them. Under this scheme, scholarships/incentives are provided to meritorious students studying in Class VI to Class XII in government schools.

fields.schemeName: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the state government provides financial assistance of ₹10,000/- as a one-time grant to the Gadia Lohar community of Rajasthan for purchasing raw materials and making themselves self-reliant in their business.

fields.schemeName: Nawabihan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide support and assistance, including legal aid and shelter, to women who are victims of domestic violence, as mandated by the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005. This scheme ensures that affected women receive the necessary resources for their well-being.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Bird’s unit 40 R.I.R. Bird’s Unit and Stipend for Poultry Farming Training
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance and training to economically weaker sections and Divyang individuals in Gujarat for poultry farming.

fields.schemeName: Providing Navigational Aids and Other Infrastructure Facilities
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to support fishermen by providing financial assistance for purchasing essential fishing equipment, life-saving gear, and infrastructure to enhance safety, efficiency, and fish preservation.

fields.schemeName: Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit
fields.briefDescription: The "Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial aid to livestock owners for setting up dairy farms, ensuring sustainable dairy production.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for C.G. Domicile Students Pursuing Engineering Courses Outside Chhattisgarh State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme supports students in their first year and fills vacant awards in subsequent years (II/III/IV). Key benefits include financial aid to cover educational expenses and encouragement for students to pursue quality education. Eligible applicants must be Chhattisgarh domicile.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste Families
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste farmers will be provided with quality planting material and other inputs for mushroom cultivation, bamboo stacking in vegetables, and protected cultivation with a subsidy of up to 90%. Additionally, training will be offered on various aspects of these practices.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Purchase Solar Power Unit/Kit for Solar Fencing around the Farm
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing solar power units/kits for solar fencing around their farms to protect crops from damage caused by wild and stray animals.

fields.schemeName: Use of Advanced Drone Technology (Agriculture Aircraft) in Agriculture Sector
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Use of Advanced Drone Technology (Agriculture Aircraft) in Agriculture Sector" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat, aims to promote the use of advanced drone technology for spraying crop protection chemicals and bio-fertilizers, etc.

fields.schemeName: Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Development of Brackish Water Aquaculture" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support the development of brackish water aquaculture through financial assistance for infrastructure, equipment, and modern shrimp farming techniques.

fields.schemeName: Special Jobs to PwDs - Clerical Assistant
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to enhance their financial independence and social inclusion. Through this scheme, PwDs are employed as Clerical Assistants for 89 Days under the District Panchayat offices of their respective islands.

fields.schemeName: Indira Priyadarshini Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among girl students by providing one-time financial rewards to those securing the first position in Class 8th, 10th, and 12th examinations, along with vocational & Swami Vivekanand Government Model Schools achievers at the district and state levels.

fields.schemeName: Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (Scheduled Tribe Category)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free BIS type II concentrate feed to pregnant cattle owned by Scheduled Tribe Category livestock owners in Gujarat to ensure their good health, boost immunity, prevent metabolic diseases, and enhance milk production.

fields.schemeName: State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide rice at subsidized rates to yellow ration card holders in the state, under which 7.50 kg of rice is distributed to each card holder every month at the rate of ₹11.00 per kg.

fields.schemeName: Establishment of Poultry Valley
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organized poultry farming among cooperative society members, especially women, by providing financial and technical support for poultry rearing, thereby enhancing income generation and livelihood opportunities in the state.

fields.schemeName: Gau Palan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote cow rearing among eligible Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries, enhancing their livelihood and income generation by providing financial support for cow rearing units.

fields.schemeName: BPL (Below Poverty Line) Student Welfare Scholarship - Technical Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of scholarships to the economically weaker students studying in government engineering and polytechnic colleges of Chhattisgarh.  The scheme offers financial aid to students enrolled in professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, girls who pass Class 8 from Kasturba Gandhi Schools, secure at least 50% marks in Class 10, & enroll in Class 11 receive an STDR of ₹2,000/- (5-year term). Those who score 50% in Class 12 and enroll in graduation receive an STDR of ₹4,000/- (3-year term).

fields.schemeName: Hon’ble Chief Minister’s Merit Scholarship Scheme-Sikkim
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide free education up to the Graduation level to talented and deserving children from underprivileged families with an opportunity to study in reputed public schools both within and outside the state.

fields.schemeName: Tiatr Script Writing Workshop
fields.briefDescription: The scheme's objective is to enrich and promote the writing skills of Tiatr playwrights and to have a healthy and constructive discussion on various aspects of Tiatr script writing amongst the Tiatr writers, participating institutions and artistes. Lunch & refreshments are provided to participants.

fields.schemeName: Bhajan Competition
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Bhajan Competition" is a Cultural scheme to preserve and promote the tradition of Bhajan singing.  Competition is organized at the Regional level and the selected group from this competition will participate at the State Level. Entries are invited through local press notes.

fields.schemeName: Chief Ministers’ Education Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from economically weaker sections, marginalized communities & specially-abled students. Under this scheme, students receive financial aid for pursuing education within & outside the state, abroad, & in registered coaching institutions.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a cash award of ₹50,000 will be given to students studying in government schools affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, who secure the highest marks in the EWS category in the Class 10th and Class 12th examinations (Arts, Commerce, and Science streams).
